items.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: thanks to the mistakes that Jimmy Carter and Fidel Castro made.

ctx.x: I don’t know if it is correct, it is like a Catch-22. I don’t know. It is very hard. Because those people wanted to come to this country to look for opportunities, and now they are denied to get into the country because the country has a situation that a half million illegal immigrants and they don’t know what to do. So at the end you know those who are suffering are the people. I’m pro-immigrant. I’m an immigrant. And I know thousands of those people have the intention of coming to this country to contribute,…
And here you are, and you arrived in the United States and within a year you’re playing with Dizzy Gillespie. Not bad.
